kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Hans in Graun im Vinschgau – Curon Venosta**

Discover authentic Italian flavors in the heart of **Tirol**! **Pizzeria Hans** in **Graun im Vinschgau** (Curon Venosta) invites you to savor delicious **pizza**, fresh pasta, and crispy **Kaiserschmarrn** in a cozy mountain atmosphere. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita** or a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, our wood-fired pizzas and regional specialties will delight your taste buds. Enjoy a warm welcome, homemade dishes, and a view of the stunning **Alpen**—just a short drive from **Innsbruck** and **Meran**. A perfect stop for families, food lovers, and travelers exploring **Südtirol**’s culinary gems.
